concepts.name: Perimeter and Area
concepts.definition: Central learning focus of Perimeter and Area.
concepts.source_evidence: 6 PERIMETER AND AREA 6.1 Perimeter Do you remember what the perimeter of a closed plane figure is?

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Support a conclusion with source information or valid working.
concepts.source_evidence: The perimeter of any closed plane figure is the distance covered along its boundary when you go around it once.

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Transfer the learned idea to a relevant new context.
concepts.source_evidence: For a polygon, i.e., a closed plane figure made up of line segments, the perimeter is simply the sum of the lengths of its all sides, i.e., the total distance along its outer boundary.
